failure_before_fix: Fighters Destiny, Tsumi to Batsu and Pilotwings 64 Birdman exhausted the CPU budget before audio. Mischief Makers later exhausted the budget after its first buffers; Pokemon Stadium produced silence. Super Mario 64 Dire, Dire Docks exhausted the budget after 6144 frames because a subnormal envelope operand raised FPE and stopped the audio thread.
fix: Use the ripper's PI interrupt timing in USF builds: immediate without both compare/FIFO tags; ROM-to-RAM length/8 or 0x1000 ticks otherwise.
Clear the saved AI interrupt when discarding the saved DMA.
Schedule initial FIFO busy completion from the restored AI length and DAC divider instead of one tick.
Use the legacy USF two-COUNT-tick instruction clock consistently in native code, precise exits and delay slots.
Complete legacy SI and AI transfers without hardware delays unless the rip opts into them.
Acknowledge startup graphics tasks with SP/DP completion stubs even when audio HLE is disabled; omit every RDP renderer and graphics walker from USF builds.
In USF builds, interpret the ripper's BREAK idle-wait markers as advance-to-next-event operations, including in branch delay slots, instead of raising breakpoint exceptions.
Allow subnormal arithmetic operands, results and conversions with gradual underflow in USF builds, matching legacy rippers. Preserve hardware FPU traps and flush behavior in normal emulator builds.

checks: Restart and skip reproduce sequential PCM at two seconds in every file-level run.
Synthetic PI completion and stale AI interrupt regression checks pass on x86/x64; the previous x86 decoder fails the new PI check.
Perfect Dark Air Force One retains its previous five-second PCM hash 70fec898c5abf7e0.
Reference lazyusf2 independently decodes all inputs; reference PCM equality is not asserted.
The previous Perfect Dark (355 s), Fighters Destiny (120 s) and Tsumi to Batsu (185 s) full-length PCM hashes are unchanged with the audio-only x64 build.
Synthetic instruction-clock, immediate SI and graphics-task completion regressions pass with audio HLE both enabled and disabled, on x86 and x64.

Standalone and JAL-delay-slot BREAK regressions verify event-time advancement and continued PCM with audio HLE enabled and disabled on x86/x64 JITs and the x64 CPU interpreter. The pre-fix interpreter decoder fails the standalone BREAK regression.
After the BREAK change, the five-second Perfect Dark, Fighters Destiny, Tsumi to Batsu, Mischief Makers and Pokemon Stadium PCM hashes remain unchanged.

Ten raw-result gradual-underflow regressions cover single/double arithmetic, inexact underflow, integer conversion and precision conversion, with FS disabled/enabled, on x86/x64 JITs and the x64 CPU interpreter. The pre-fix x64 decoder fails the first regression.
The non-USF FPU header preprocesses to identical tokens before and after the subnormal change. Six previous tracks, including Birdman, retain their five-second PCM hashes.
MSVC x86/x64 import libraries and actual delay-loaded consumers link and run successfully.
Sixteen Windows/Linux/Pi build configurations pass Make dry runs; USF compile lists contain no RDP, display-list or image/video decoder sources. Six unsupported configurations are rejected.
